'''Hangar Bay 31''' was a hangar bay on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. [[Nera Dantels]] docked her ship ''[[Starduster]]'' there in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] for a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|meeting]] with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] and [[Cesi Eirriss]].
